book_title: 小蓝本高中卷9 不等式的解题与技巧
title: 实数 $a_{1}, a_{2}, \cdots, a_{n}(n\geqslant3)$ 满足
stem_md:
实数 $a_{1}, a_{2}, \cdots, a_{n}(n\geqslant3)$ 满足: $a_{1}+a_{2}+\cdots+a_{n}=0$, 且 $2a_{k}\leqslant a_{k-1}+a_{k+1}, k=2, 3, \cdots, n-1$. 求最小的 $\lambda(n)$, 使得对所有 $k\in\{1, 2, \cdots, n\}$, 都有

$|a_{k}|\leqslant\lambda(n)\cdot\max\{|a_{1}|, |a_{n}|\}.$
solution_md:
解析 首先, 取 $a_{1}=1, a_{2}=-\frac{n+1}{n-1}, a_{k}=\frac{n+1}{n-1}+\frac{2n(k-2)}{(n-1)(n-2)}, k=3, 4, \cdots, n$, 则满足 $a_{1}+a_{2}+\cdots+a_{n}=0$ 及 $2a_{k}\leqslant a_{k-1}+a_{k+1}, k=2, 3, \cdots, n-1$. 此时

$\lambda(n)\geqslant\frac{n+1}{n-1}.$

下证当 $\lambda(n)=\frac{n+1}{n-1}$ 时, 对所有 $k\in\{1, 2, \cdots, n\}$, 都有

$|a_{k}|\leqslant\lambda(n)\cdot\max\{|a_{1}|, |a_{n}|\}.$

因为 $2a_{k}\leqslant a_{k-1}+a_{k+1}$, 所以 $a_{k+1}-a_{k}\geqslant a_{k}-a_{k-1}$, 于是

$a_{j}\leqslant\frac{1}{k-1}[(j-1)a_{k}+(k-j)a_{1}],$

当 $k\leqslant j\leqslant n$ 时, $a_{j}\leqslant\frac{1}{n-k}[(j-k)a_{n}+(n-j)a_{k}],$

所以 $\sum_{j=1}^{k}a_{j}\leqslant\frac{1}{k-1}\sum_{j=1}^{k}[(j-1)a_{k}+(k-j)a_{1}]=\frac{k}{2}(a_{1}+a_{k}),$

$\sum_{j=k}^{n}a_{j}\leqslant\frac{1}{n-k}\sum_{j=k}^{n}[(j-k)a_{n}+(n-j)a_{k}]=\frac{n+1-k}{2}(a_{k}+a_{n}),$

相加得

$a_{k}=\sum_{j=1}^{k}a_{j}+\sum_{j=k}^{n}a_{j}\leqslant\frac{k}{2}(a_{1}+a_{k})+\frac{n+1-k}{2}(a_{k}+a_{n}),$

即

$a_{k}\geqslant-\frac{1}{n-1}[ka_{1}+(n+1-k)a_{n}].$

由(1)、(2)得

$|a_{k}|\leqslant\max\left\{\frac{1}{n-1}|(k-1)a_{n}+(n-k)a_{1}|, \frac{1}{n-1}|ka_{1}+(n+1-k)a_{n}|\right\}\leqslant\frac{n+1}{n-1}\max\{|a_{1}|, |a_{n}|\}, k=2, 3, \cdots, n-1.$

综上所述, $\lambda(n)_{\min}=\frac{n+1}{n-1}.$
